theorems.name: Submission.p04_ht_restricted_standard_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (n : ℕ), Nonempty (((((Rep.resFunctor (k := k) H.subtype).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj (Rep.standardComplex k G)).coinvariantsTensorObj (Rep.res H.subtype A)).homology n ≃ₗ[k] groupHomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n)
theorems.natural_summary: Restrict the standard projective resolution to H using exactness and preservation of projectives. Apply the pinned library’s groupHomologyIso to this resolution, invert the resulting isomorphism, and convert it to a k-linear equivalence. This applies in every degree without flatness or projectivity of A.
